hints.title: Unique Entry Counting
hints.text: For each participant submission, eliminate internal duplicates so each distinct string is counted at most once per survey.

hints.title: Global Frequency Aggregation
hints.text: Aggregate total occurrences across all participant sets using a count mapping.

hints.title: Lexicographical Tie-breaking
hints.text: Filter responses with the highest frequency and return the lexicographically smallest.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: M: total number of response words across all lists
complexity.notes: Hash map frequency aggregation identifies maximum frequency with linear pass tie-breaking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not deduplicating items per response violates problem specifications.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Frequency map holds distinct words in proportional space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduplicate per list and resolve ties using lexicographical order.
